name: browse_category_and_open_post
description: Navigate a WordPress category archive, select a sidebar category by category id, open a post by title or index, and click its 'Continue Reading' link. Uses recorded stable selectors and prefers href-based selection. Assumes the session is already authenticated if needed.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the requested category page using the category query parameter.
Wait for the category page to load and render.
Capture the visible post titles and links and the sidebar categories for verification.
steps.goal: Extract list of posts (title and href) and confirm presence of sidebar category link 'cat={category_id}'

steps.description: Use deterministic href-based selection first; fall back to XPath by link text scoped to the categories widget if necessary.
steps.task: Locate the sidebar category link with href containing '?cat={category_id}' and click it if found

steps.description: Wait briefly after clicking to allow navigation.
Validate that URL or heading contains the category id or name; extract titles and hrefs.
steps.goal: Verify the page is now the requested category and extract updated post list

steps.description: Prefer exact text match using XPath; fallback to post link href by '?p=' IDs captured earlier.
steps.task: Open the post. If post_title provided find anchor whose visible text equals '{post_title}' and click it. Otherwise use the {post_index}-th post title link from the extracted list and click it.

steps.description: Wait for the post page to load.
Capture the post title and permalink for verification.
steps.goal: Confirm post page loaded and extract main post title and permalink

steps.description: Attempt to click the post's 'Continue Reading' link to open the full post. If not found, click the post title link instead.
steps.task: Click the 'Continue Reading' link on the post listing if present. Use selectors a.more-link, a.read-more, or article a[href*='?p='] falling back to XPath //a[contains(normalize-space(.),'Continue Reading')].

steps.description: Wait for navigation after Continue Reading click.
Return the post URL, title, and success status.
steps.goal: Final verification: extract and return the full post URL and title

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Base site URL including scheme and host (e.g., http://localhost:8000). Tool will navigate category and post URLs relative to this base.

input_schema.name: category_id
input_schema.description: Numeric category id to open from the sidebar (e.g., '16' for technology). This is used in href queries like '?cat={category_id}'.

input_schema.name: post_title
input_schema.description: Exact post title to open from the category listing. If provided the tool will find the title link matching this text; exact match preferred. If omitted, the first post (index 1) will be used.

input_schema.name: post_index
input_schema.description: 1-based index of the post to open from the listing when post_title is not provided. Defaults to 1.

input_schema.name: wait_seconds
input_schema.description: Seconds to wait after navigation or clicks for pages to load. Defaults to 2.
